transcript.text: Good morning, Mr. Chen. Before we get into attendance details, I do have an important update regarding family communication. I confirmed with the student's guardian just today that the family cannot attend after-school meetings. Instead, they've requested a school phone check-in at exactly 3:30 p.m. each school day during the first week back. I haven't yet updated the family-contact section of the plan since the guardian only confirmed this arrangement today, but I wanted to make sure everyone is aware as we prepare for Dr. Morgan's review.

transcript.text: I need to share an important health update. I've verified the physician's return note for the student. It specifies two requirements: first, the student must have no physical exertion, including physical education, for exactly 10 school days after returning. Second, the student's prescribed midday medication must be stored and administered in the nurse's office. I have not yet uploaded the note to the student-health system, but I wanted everyone to be aware of these requirements before Dr. Morgan signs the re-entry plan.
